newsitem.title: USA: MCN unit files shelf for mortgage bonds.
newsitem.headline: MCN unit files shelf for mortgage bonds.

text.p: Michigan Consolidated Gas Co, a subsidiary of MCN Corp, filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday for a shelf offering of up to $260 million of first mortgage bonds.
An additional $40 million of previously registered first mortgage bonds also are being carried forward into this offering, the company said.
Proceeds from the sale will be used to acquire property, add or improve existing facilities, for working capital, to improve or maintain service, repay debt and for other corporate purposes, it said.
The company did not name underwriters for the offering but said they may include Merrill Lynch & Co.
Michigan Consolidated is public utility company engaged in the distribution and transmission of natural gas in the state of Michigan.
